name: Cold outreach to a technical buyer
description: Short first touch that leads with their problem.
subject: Quick idea for your platform team
body:
Hi {{name}},

I noticed your team is scaling deploys. We cut release time by 40% for teams like yours. Worth a 15 minute chat?

Best,
Alex

name: Interview invitation
description: Warm invite with three time options.
subject: Interview for the Senior Engineer role
body:
Hi {{name}},

Thanks for applying. Could you do Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday afternoon for a 45 minute interview?

Alex

name: Weekly executive update
subject: Weekly update: wins, risks, asks
body:
Team,

Wins: shipped billing v2. Risks: vendor delay. Asks: approval for two hires.

Alex

name: Follow up after a demo
description: Polite nudge two days after a demo.
subject: Following up on Tuesday's demo
body:
Hi {{name}},

Thanks for your time on Tuesday. Happy to answer questions or share the pricing deck.

Alex

name: Apology for a missed deadline
description: Own the miss, give a new date.
subject: Apologies for the delay
body:
Hi {{name}},

I am sorry we missed the Friday deadline. The corrected report will reach you by Wednesday noon.

Alex
